text: AI is changing how we think about creativity. Today, computers can create art, write stories, and even compose music. These tools learn from huge amounts of data and then produce something new. But is it truly creative? Human creativity comes from emotions, personal experiences, and imagination. A machine can copy styles and mix ideas, but it does not feel joy, sadness, or surprise. Many people believe AI is a helpful tool, not a replacement for human artists. It can give us new ideas and speed up our work. In the end, creativity may become a partnership between people and machines.
